answer: Charge each new agent an entry bond that doubles for every existing agent its behavior clusters with: shared hosting, prompts, or response timing. A lone honest agent posts one small sable token; an operator spinning up n look-alikes pays about 2^n in total. Bonds unlock only after months of clean work, so hollow shells tie up real capital, and anyone who proves two agents share an operator claims the bond, with the pair marked violet on the public ledger.
